text:
Ravi: quick sync  We need a keyword allocation matrix for the upcoming benchmark blog + two launch posts + webinar. Goal: no title/meta cannibalization and clear primary targets. Publish window: next Tue 09:00 PT.
Asha: I'll draft the matrix. Quick rules: 1) one primary keyword per page; 2) secondary keywords may overlap; 3) use long-tail variations on webinar landing to capture 'how to' queries.
Marco: suggested primaries: benchmark blog = "inference benchmarks"; launch post A (platform) = "predictable inference"; launch post B (ops) = "inference at scale"; webinar landing = "inference benchmark webinar". Thoughts?
Ravi: good start. prefer removing exact-match primary from both a launch post and the blog. Maybe swap launch post A primary to "llm latency optimization" to diversify.
Asha: I'll export a CSV: columns = keyword, search_volume, intent, recommended_page, primary/secondary, notes. Will flag SERP features (PAA/snippets).
Lina: schema notes: blog/launch posts = Article + breadcrumbList + SocialMeta; webinar = Event + FAQ + sameAs for speakers. FAQ items should mirror PAA where possible. Keep Qs short.
Marco: internal linking plan: put contextual link to benchmark blog from product overview, add resource card for webinar on /resources, and link launch posts to each other with a cross-link paragraph. Anchors: "inference benchmarks", "LLM latency".
Ravi: redirects: consolidate legacy paths under /blog/* and /resources/* into new canonical URLs with 301. Use CSV for redirect ship. Preserve utm for partner redirects but canonical must be clean.
seo-bot: staging-scan: found 3 orphan pages without canonical tags: /old-bench, /campaign/latency2025, /tmp/benchmark-draft. Recommend add canonical meta and queue redirect.
Asha: timeline: CSV with allocation + redirect draft by Thu EOD, Marco to drop internal link PR Fri, Lina to post JSON-LD snippets Fri noon, Ravi to run preflight Sat.
Marco: small UX note  for webinar add structured data with speaker objects (jobTitle minimal) to surface rich cards.
Ravi: tagging owners: @Asha (keyword matrix + redirect CSV), @Marco (links + PR), @Lina (schema), @seo-bot for crawl checks. I'll consolidate and post final CSV to #marketing-assets. :rocket:
